name: SATX transfer logic leaves skimmable surplus in its pair
summary: SATX's transfer logic leaves SATX in the SATX/WBNB pair above its recorded reserves; the attacker repeatedly skimmed and synced the pair to drain its SATX side and then withdrew its WBNB.
notes: Loss is the pair's WBNB; its SATX is valued at nothing (rule 12).
